Genesis 1:5, 8, 13, 19, 23, 31. “And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.” “And God called the firmament Heaven. Mark 1:32 “And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.”
